An agenda for your advisors’ priorities, capabilities and next steps.
LIBERTY MUTUAL | INDEPENDENT AGENTS
Subject: Watkins: a focused construction planning session

Put your construction priorities on the agenda

Hello Patrick,

Watkins pairs risk assessment with mitigation and ongoing advocacy. As you begin the next chapter with Sequel, could we put that approach at the center of a 30-minute construction planning session with your team?

We could use the time to:

  • Identify contractor risks your advisors want to explore.
  • Review relevant Liberty Mutual underwriting, risk control and claims capabilities.
  • Choose one topic for a producer and service-team working session.

The goal is a short action plan shaped around Watkins’ priorities, whether that means a deeper technical conversation or a useful resource for the team.

Our construction overview gives you a starting point for choosing the discussion. If the session would be useful, reply with a priority and the colleague you would like to involve.
